general.title: L2P Multi-Comparison Pathway Analysis
general.instructions:
START HERE:
1. **Single flat file**: Leave 'DEG Table File' blank — auto-detected from attached dataset
2. **MOSuite moo-properties asset (filtered)**: Set 'DEG Table File' to Filtered DEG — loads analyses/diff_filt.csv
3. **MOSuite moo-properties asset (all comparisons)**: Set 'DEG Table File' to All DEG — loads and merges diff_{comparison}.csv files
4. **Explicit path**: Set 'DEG Table File' to a full path e.g. /data/moo-properties/analyses/diff_filt.csv

Set 'Comparisons' to the comparison IDs in your data. Configure Basic Settings and run.

datasets.name: Demo DEG Table
datasets.help_text: Mouse RNA-seq demo data with 3 comparisons (B-A, C-A, B-C). Used automatically if no file is uploaded.

categories.name: Column Overrides
categories.help_text: Override auto-detected column names if needed

categories.name: Custom Pathways (Optional)
categories.help_text: Use your own pathway database instead of or in addition to built-in collections

parameters.name: DEG Table File
parameters.help_text: Controls input mode. Leave blank to auto-detect a single flat file. Set to 'Filtered DEG' to load analyses/diff_filt.csv from a moo-properties asset. Set to 'All DEG' to load and merge per-comparison diff_{comparison}.csv files. Or enter a full file path (e.g. /data/moo-properties/analyses/diff_filt.csv).

parameters.name: Gene Names Column
parameters.help_text: Name of the column containing gene symbols (e.g. GeneName for MOSuite output, Gene for other formats)

parameters.name: Comparisons
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated comparison IDs (e.g. 'B-A,C-A,B-C'). Used to find per-comparison files in All DEG mode (diff_B-A.csv etc.) and to derive column names.

parameters.name: Species
parameters.help_text: Species for ortholog mapping. Non-human genes are converted to human before L2P analysis

parameters.name: Pathway Collections
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated pathway collections: GO, REACTOME, KEGG, H (Hallmark), C1-C8 (MSigDB), WikiPathways. Leave blank if using only custom pathways

parameters.name: T-Statistic Columns
parameters.help_text: T-statistic column name. For MOSuite per-comparison files (All DEG mode): single name e.g. tstat — the comparison prefix is added automatically. For combined tables: comma-separated e.g. B-A_tstat, C-A_tstat.

parameters.name: Significance Columns
parameters.help_text: Significance (p-value) column name. For MOSuite per-comparison files (All DEG mode): single name e.g. adjpval. For combined tables: comma-separated e.g. B-A_adjpval, C-A_adjpval.

parameters.name: Fold Change Columns
parameters.help_text: Fold change column name. For MOSuite per-comparison files (All DEG mode): single name e.g. FC. For combined tables: comma-separated e.g. B-A_FC, C-A_FC.

parameters.name: Select By Rank
parameters.help_text: Select genes by rank (recommended) or by significance/fold change thresholds

parameters.name: Select Top Percentage
parameters.help_text: Select top percentage of genes (vs fixed number)

parameters.name: Number of Top Genes
parameters.help_text: Number of top genes to select (if not using percentage)

parameters.name: Significance Threshold
parameters.help_text: P-value threshold for gene selection (if not using rank)

parameters.name: Fold Change Threshold
parameters.help_text: Fold change threshold for gene selection (if not using rank)

parameters.name: Minimum DEG Genes
parameters.help_text: Minimum number of DEG genes required per comparison

parameters.name: Top Pathways to Compare
parameters.help_text: Number of top pathways to include in comparison across groups

parameters.name: Minimum Significant Events
parameters.help_text: Minimum number of comparisons where pathway must be significant

parameters.name: Maximum Pathways to Plot
parameters.help_text: Maximum number of pathways to display in the bubble plot

parameters.name: Minimum Pathway Hits
parameters.help_text: Minimum genes required per pathway to be considered

parameters.name: Pathway Size Limit
parameters.help_text: Maximum pathway size (pathways with more genes are excluded)

parameters.name: P-value Threshold
parameters.help_text: P-value cutoff for including pathways in results (0 = include all)

parameters.name: Use Built-in Gene Universe
parameters.help_text: Use built-in gene universe instead of detected genes

parameters.name: Use FDR P-values
parameters.help_text: Use FDR-adjusted p-values for pathway significance

parameters.name: Update Gene Symbols
parameters.help_text: Update gene symbols to current nomenclature

parameters.name: Custom Pathway File
parameters.help_text: Select custom pathway file from attached data assets (TSV/CSV format). Leave blank to use only standard collections.

parameters.name: Pathway Name Column
parameters.help_text: Column name containing pathway names in custom file

parameters.name: Gene Symbol Column
parameters.help_text: Column name containing gene symbols in custom file

parameters.name: Bubble Size Metric
parameters.help_text: Metric to determine bubble size

parameters.name: Bubble Color Metric
parameters.help_text: Metric to determine bubble color gradient

parameters.name: Bubble Max Color Value
parameters.help_text: Maximum value for color scale gradient

parameters.name: Pathway Label Max Length
parameters.help_text: Maximum character length for pathway names

parameters.name: Pathway Label Font Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for pathway labels

parameters.name: Dynamic Pathway Font Size
parameters.help_text: Automatically adjust pathway label font size based on number of pathways

parameters.name: X-Axis Title
parameters.help_text: Optional custom title for the x-axis. Leave blank for no title

parameters.name: Y-Axis Title
parameters.help_text: Optional custom title for the y-axis. Leave blank for no title

parameters.name: X-Axis Title Font Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for x-axis title

parameters.name: Y-Axis Title Font Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for y-axis title

parameters.name: X-Axis Tick Font Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for x-axis tick labels

parameters.name: X-Axis Tick Labels
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated custom labels for x-axis ticks. Must match number of comparisons. Leave blank to use defaults

parameters.name: Y-Axis Tick Labels
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated custom labels for y-axis ticks. Must match number of pathways. Leave blank to use defaults

parameters.name: Pathways to Remove
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated list of pathway names to exclude from plot

parameters.name: Rename Groups
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated new names for comparison groups (must match number of comparisons)

parameters.name: Vertical Line Placement
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated positions for vertical separator lines between groups

parameters.name: Custom Pathway Order
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated pathway names to define custom Y-axis order

parameters.name: Use Panel Plot
parameters.help_text: Use panel layout (splits comparisons into separate panels)

parameters.name: Column Spacing
parameters.help_text: Spacing between comparison columns in the plot

parameters.name: Plot Width
parameters.help_text: Plot width in inches

parameters.name: Plot Height
parameters.help_text: Plot height in inches

parameters.name: Output Plot Path
parameters.help_text: File path for output bubble plot

parameters.name: Output Results Path
parameters.help_text: File path for output results table
